notes:
v4.6.44 — Bot pages now show ALL data (running or not), load fast, + the buy-cash fix

🐛 FIXED — bot pages showing no data (especially crypto, and on IBKR)
• IBKR positions & equity history never loaded on the IBKR page — the data path wasn't wired to IBKR. Now it is, so your IBKR positions and equity curve show.
• Every bot tab now loads in TWO phases: your saved history (trades, snapshots, charts) paints INSTANTLY from local files, then live broker data (account, positions) fills in. So:
   – a bot that ISN'T running still shows all its history and charts,
   – a slow or unreachable broker no longer leaves the page blank,
   – pages feel much faster.
• Each piece of data now loads independently — one slow/failed call can no longer blank the whole page (which is what was wiping the crypto bot's display).

🐛 FIXED — repeating 'insufficient balance' on buys (Alpaca AND IBKR)
• Before any buy, the bot now caps the order to the cash actually spendable right now (Alpaca free cash / IBKR sub-portfolio slice), so an over-sized order shrinks to fit instead of being rejected every cycle. If there's truly no free cash it skips cleanly.

If a bot runs on Oracle, restart it so it picks up the buy-cash fix.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
